title: Podcast Tour Anchorage Mud, Concrete, and Wild Air
includes: Verified facts woven into an engaging story
Interactive in-app guide for questions about the story and surroundings
Immersive podcast-style audio featuring experts and locals
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the story of Anchorage, where a chaotic 1915 tent city on mudflats transformed into a Cold War military crossroads and modern metropolis. Guided by urban planner Tom and detail-obsessed Claudia, you will explore rail yards, pioneer storefronts, earthquake scars, and glass museums pressed directly against the Alaskan wilderness.

- A 3.7 km self-guided tour with 8 stops over 127 min
- Ideal for travelers interested in Urbanism, Infrastructure & Innovation and History & Memory
- Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
- Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app
